name: Modified Borg RPE Scale
description: Patient-reported perceived exertion on a 6–20 scale during exercise. Correlates with heart rate (~scale × 10).
copyright: Public Domain (original 1970 Borg scale; NOT Modified CR10 which is proprietary)
shirleySays: Correlates with HR (multiply by ~10 for est. HR). ICC 0.88–0.98. MDC: ~2 points. Used widely in cardiac rehab, COPD, heart failure, and exercise testing. Target RPE 12–14 (moderate) for general therapeutic exercise. NOTE: Use original 6-20 scale; Borg CR10 is proprietary.
